subject: Change to the courtyard event
text:
Hello,

I wanted to pass along an update about the courtyard gathering this weekend. The organizers have just confirmed that the setup crew cannot begin until noon, so the event will now start fifteen minutes later than posted. The raffle table should still open at four, and the short welcome remarks will run at forty-five after the hour. If you were planning to arrive early to help with the chairs, the current guidance is to come no sooner than one. This change only affects tomorrow. The earlier flyer may still be in the mailbox, so please ignore the posted start time if you are only attending the opening remarks. I hope it does not inconvenience your plans too much, but I thought it better to let you know as soon as possible.

With thanks,
A neighbor
